reason: I get my abayas for $20 to $30 on Amazon or TikTok Shop and wait for sales, so $45 for an everyday one, or $75 to $80 for a thobe, is more than I usually pay, even with 15% off. Driving out to Westchase on a Sunday to look at racks that might not be my style isn't worth it for me.
objection: The styles could be too Arab-specific or too plain for me, and I'm not part of that community, so I'm not sure I'd feel like it was made for me. And I can get something similar online for half the price.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing pieces in colors and cuts that fit my taste, at a real sale price on the everyday abayas (around $30), would get me to stop by.
